instruction: Fix solution.py. order(deps) takes a dict from string node names to lists of prerequisite node names. Nodes mentioned only as prerequisites also count. Return a topological ordering, always choosing the lexicographically smallest currently available node. Duplicate prerequisites count once. Raise ValueError for any cycle. Do not mutate deps. Keep the implementation in solution.py and use only the Python standard library. Run `python3 test_solution.py` to check the examples. Do not edit the tests. The implementation must satisfy the specification for other inputs too. After fixing the implementation, the final answer is DONE. Work only inside the current directory. When you are done, write ONLY the final answer to the file answer.txt in the current directory.
